gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Vantrue's $149.99 4G LTE module only works when it is powered from a hardwire kit (not the 12 V plug), or that the maker's compatibility list (S1 Pro, N2X, E360, E360 Ace, S1 Pro Max, N4S, E1 Pro, N5S, N4PS) leaves out the original N4 Pro. That means a rideshare driver who wants live remote view or cloud alerts has to buy an N4S, N4 Pro S or N5S, plus the module, plus a hardwire kit.
standout_why: I compared against the three cited rivals. productbible.com (2026-11-19) gives the LTE module price ($149.99, with '$9.99 for 2GB per 30 days') and says the N4S and N5S have 'LTE module support'. It does not say the module needs a hardwire kit, and it names no model the module excludes. dashlore.com (2026-11-17) says only 'LTE needs an add-on 4G module' for the N5S, and lists LTE/cloud as 'No' for every pick. redlinecargarage.com (Oct 2026) ranks the original Vantrue N4 Pro 'Best Overall' and never mentions LTE, so nothing warns that the N4 Pro cannot take the module. I did not open any other top result for this point.
decides: This confirms the N4 Pro S over the older N4 Pro that a cited rival ranks first, for any driver who wants remote view or cloud incident alerts between rides. Only the N4S, N4 Pro S and N5S on these pages are on Vantrue's LTE list. VIOFO sells no LTE option (per productbible). It also changes the real cost of a connected setup: camera + $149.99 module + a hardwire kit ($24.99 to $34.99 at vantrue.com on 2026-11-21). Vantrue's own N4 Pro S + VP03 + 512GB + CPL + LTE bundle was $607.99 the same day. The ranking stays the same, with our N4 Pro S (vantrue-nexus-4-pro-s) as the pick and the N5S (vantrue-nexus-5s) as the 4-channel option. The page should state the module plus hardwire requirement as part of the LTE cost.

findings.source_title: 4G LTE Module with SIM Card – Vantrue
findings.note: Maker text: 'The provided SIM card comes with an initial 300MB of data. After the data is used up, customers will need to recharge the card themselves.' This conflicts with productbible's '$9.99 for 2GB per 30 days', which I could not find on a maker page. The same text says S1 Pro, E360 ACE and E360 need their latest firmware to activate cloud features; it gives no firmware note for the N4S, N4 Pro S or N5S.

findings.label: Power requirement
findings.value: Must be used with a hardwire kit and a microSD card in the camera; the module's Type-C lead goes into the dash cam's power port
findings.note: This is Vantrue's LT01 manual hosted by ManualsLib, not by Vantrue. It says the box 'needs to be used with a hardwire kit' and recommends Vantrue's kit, and 'needs to be used with a SD card'. Activation happens in the Vantrue Connected app, and live Wi-Fi preview is not available remotely. The manual's translation calls the module a 'WIFI box'. I could not open Vantrue's own manual page (vantrue.net/usermanual/lt01 returned only an S1 Pro guide shell).

findings.label: Hardwire kits the maker names for these cameras
findings.value: Voltage Display Hardwire Kit $29.99 (lists N4S, N4 Pro S, N5S); 5-Level Adjustable Hardwire Kit $34.99 (title lists N4S, N4 Pro S, N5S); Universal 11.5 ft ACC Hardwire Kit $24.99 ('only work for Vantrue dash cam'). All 12–24 V, Type-C.
findings.note: Prices and text come from the maker's US store records (also https://www.vantrue.com/products/5-level-adjustable-hardwire-kit and https://www.vantrue.com/products/universal-11-5ft-acc-hardwire-kit) via storecheck.py. The 5-Level kit contradicts itself: its title names N4S, N4 Pro S and N5S, but its body says it 'only work[s] for N4 N5 N4 Pro and E1, E2, S2-2CH, S2-3CH, N2S, X4S, T3'. Low-voltage cutoffs: 11.6 V/23.2 V (Universal); 11.6/12/12.4 V (Voltage Display); 11.6–12.5 V plus a timer (5-Level).

findings.label: Card limit and LTE mention
findings.value: microSD up to 512 GB; the maker's feature list has no LTE item. The N4 Pro S lists 'Optional LTE Live Monitoring' and up to 1 TB.
findings.note: Maker store records via storecheck.py. The N4 Pro S line is from https://www.vantrue.com/products/n4-pro-s ($279.99, list $469.99). New N4 Pro units appear only in bundles (e.g. N4 Pro + VP03 + 256GB + CPL $319.96); refurbished N4 Pro is $189.99.
